claims.text: A committed blank is a hashed hypothesis of a refused lexeme. The blank is not intent.
A letter, digit, or word-shaped character in the slot refuses the hash. The held text is not decoded.
The disconfirm line is a later sentence about what would falsify the row. It does not fill the slot.
A machine-decode-claim source labels a public claim. It does not load a decoder and does not set received.
